title: 第2169章 官员制度第2168章 开拓证书
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：领主：从开拓骑士开始第一卷：默认第2169章官员制度（..la）“倘若以后国家面积继续扩大，可在此框架下继续增加等级即可，无需在推翻重新建立一套新的体系。”
“很好。”维林开口赞同道，“我认为这样非常不错。”
“主上，我认为这套体系很好。”凯尔点了点头，开口说道。
“至于地方行政划分，镇设立镇长，县设立县长，郡设立郡长，省设立总督，三个大区设立总署。”
“以县一级为例，县长负责整个县的政治事务，但在县之外，将税务，治安与地方守备这三个模块划分出来，平时由县长代管，但他们直属上级归属郡一级税务，治安与地方守备这三个部门手中，且这些位置三年一轮换，杜绝形成三头派系。”
“至于地方上原有的驻军，则归入军方，该裁撤就裁撤，该整编就整编，总之贯彻一个原则，军队归于王国，地方不允许染指。”
“以县为模板，在郡和省一级建立相应部门。”
“至于大区这一级，需要增设粮库局，负责粮食物资存储。”
“国家层面上，属下建议设立监察署，负责监察官员；设立军法总局，负责对军队内部审查。”
“另外再设立一个秘密部门，直接对主上您负责，负责监控监察署与军法总局。”
“如此一来，以三级监察结构，可掌控王国的局势。”
说完之后，贝尔德看向维林，安静等待。
面对贝尔德注视，维林轻咳一声，开口说道：“这个架构很不错，我认为可以按照这个架构来搭建新的体系。”
“另外，我们可以借鉴伊利亚王国的审查部队，单独设立审查署，下设爵位审查部，战功核查部以及治安巡查部。”
“对于超凡资源的开发与培育方面，设立资源整合署，专门负责这方面的事务。”
确定基本架构后，三人围绕着各个官署讨论了起来。
仅仅一个下午的时间，王国未来的架构就在三人的讨论中诞生。
国家层面，设立行政署，粮库总局，税务署，治安署，教育总局，监察署，军法总局，审查署，外交署，资源整合署，三个大区总署，以及军务总局，合计设立十四个国家层面的官署，每个官署或总局设立一名大臣，即为九级执政官。
而在这十四位大臣外，还会设立三位宫廷大臣，作为国王的近臣，负责处理国家事务。
对于这个提议，贝尔德提出了反对意见，凯尔保持沉默，但还是被维林以不要脸的精神强行通过。

他是来当国王的，不是来当牛马的，有值得信赖的下属，那就要放权，这样自己才能轻松，才有时间去做其他事情。
要是每天将时间空耗在政务当中，那他当这个国王还有什么意义。
“在十七位九级执政官之上，我会再设立三名十级执政官。”
“至于人选的话，你们想不想知道。”
“不想。”贝尔德闻言，摇着头说道，语气没有丝毫犹豫。
凯尔见状，开口附和道：“属下也一样。”
“既然这样的话，那我偏要说。”维林放下茶杯，不紧不慢的说道，“三名十级执政官，贝尔德你算一个，凯尔你也是其中一个，最后一人是奥兰多。”
“至于官名，就称作宰相，也可叫做相。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Lord: Starting from the Pioneer Knights Volume 1: Default Chapter 2169 Official System (..la) "If the country continues to expand in size in the future, it can continue to increase levels within this framework, without overthrowing and establishing a new system."
"Very good." Verin agreed, "I think this is very good."
"Lord, I think this system is very good." Kyle nodded and said.
"As for the division of local administration, the town has a town mayor, the county has a county chief, the county has a county chief, the province has a governor, and the three regions have general administrations."
"Take the county level as an example. The county magistrate is responsible for the political affairs of the entire county. However, outside the county, the three modules of taxation, public security and local security are divided into three modules. They are usually managed by the county magistrate. However, their direct superiors are in the hands of the county-level taxation, security and local security departments. These positions rotate every three years to prevent the formation of a three-headed faction."
"As for the original local garrisons, they will be classified as military. If they need to be dismantled, they will be dismantled. If they need to be reorganized, they will be reorganized. In short, one principle will be implemented. The army belongs to the kingdom and the local government is not allowed to interfere."
“Using the county as a template, we will establish corresponding departments at the county and provincial levels.”
"As for the regional level, it is necessary to add a grain storage bureau to be responsible for the storage of grain materials."
"At the national level, subordinates suggested the establishment of an Inspection Office, responsible for supervising officials; and the establishment of the General Administration of Military Justice, responsible for internal review of the military."
"In addition, a secret department will be established, which will be directly responsible to you, the Lord. It will be responsible for monitoring the Supervision Bureau and the General Administration of Military Justice."
"In this way, the situation in the kingdom can be controlled with a three-level supervision structure."
After finishing speaking, Baird looked at Verin and waited quietly.
Facing Baird's gaze, Verin coughed lightly and said, "This structure is very good. I think a new system can be built according to this structure."
"In addition, we can learn from the review force of the Kingdom of Ilia and set up a separate review office, which consists of the title review department, the combat merit verification department and the security inspection department."
"For the development and cultivation of extraordinary resources, a Resource Integration Agency has been established to be responsible for this aspect."
After determining the basic structure, the three of them discussed various government offices.
In just one afternoon, the future structure of the kingdom was born in the discussion between the three people.
At the national level, there are the Administrative Department, the General Administration of Grain, the Taxation Department, the Public Security Bureau, the General Administration of Education, the Inspection Office, the General Administration of Military Justice, the Inspection Office, the Foreign Affairs Office, the Resource Integration Administration, three regional general administrations, and the General Administration of Military Affairs. There are a total of fourteen official offices at the national level. Each official office or general administration has a minister, who is the ninth-level consul.
In addition to these fourteen ministers, three palace ministers will be established as close ministers of the king to handle national affairs.
Baird raised objections to this proposal, and Kyle remained silent, but Verin forced it through in a shameless spirit.
He is here to be a king, not a cow or horse. If he has trustworthy subordinates, he must delegate authority so that he can relax and have time to do other things.
If he spends his time in government affairs every day, then what's the point of being a king.
"On top of the seventeen ninth-level consuls, I will establish three more tenth-level consuls."
"As for the candidates, do you want to know?"
"I don't want to." Baird shook his head and said without any hesitation.
Kyle saw this and echoed: "The same goes for my subordinates."
"If that's the case, then I have to say it." Verin put down the tea cup and said calmly, "There are three tenth-level consuls, Baird is one of them, Kyle is also one of them, and the last one is Orlando."
"As for the official name, it is called prime minister, or prime minister."
